# Report usage across every tool round, not just the last

Issue: re-cinq/HALEngine#93
Labels: priority:medium, type:feature, size:S, area:api

## Why

`afterModelResponse` is the hook a deployer reaches for when they need to record what a turn cost — an audit entry, a billing line, a usage budget. It is called once per user message, after the round loop exits, and is handed the `lastUsage` local: `chatOrchestrator.ts` assigns `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` on each round, so what the hook receives is the usage of the final provider call alone.

For a turn that answered directly, that is the whole turn. For a turn that called tools, it is the last leg of several, and the earlier rounds — including the one carrying the customer's question and the full tool results — are not counted anywhere. A deployer billing or budgeting from this hook under-counts exactly the expensive turns, and nothing in the signature hints at it. The current behaviour is recorded in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` so it is at least discoverable, but documenting a surprising number is weaker than not producing one.

Raised by the reviewer on HALEngine#83, which recorded the behaviour but could not change it: that PR's ticket scoped itself to specifying the seam, not altering the orchestrator.

## What to do

Decide, and make the signature say the answer. Two shapes are worth weighing, and the issue should record why the other was rejected:

- Accumulate across rounds and pass the sum, keeping one `usage` argument. Simple for the common case, and it silently changes what an existing consumer records — the number gets larger for tool-heavy turns, which is the point, but it is a behaviour change worth a MINOR bump and a changelog line that says so.
- Pass both, for example the summed total plus the per-round breakdown, so a consumer that wants provider-call granularity keeps it. More faithful, wider surface.

Whichever is chosen, a turn that ran no tools must report exactly what it reports today, so the common path does not move.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A turn driven through two tool rounds reports usage covering every provider call in that turn, asserted against a scripted provider whose rounds report known, different token counts
- [ ] A turn with no tool calls reports exactly what it reports today, pinned by the existing test remaining unedited
- [ ] A provider that reports no usage on some rounds does not make the total `undefined` or `NaN`: the rounds that reported are still counted, and a turn where nothing reported still reports nothing
- [ ] The type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous, so a reader does not have to open the orchestrator to learn whether it is a sum
- [ ] `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` replaces its recorded under-counting line with the new behaviour, and the CHANGELOG entry states the change in what an existing consumer will record
- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run eslint` (`--max-warnings 0`) and `npm run prettier:check` pass, with no `any` in the public API

## Tech notes

Out of scope: the audit entry or billing record itself, which is a consumer's concern; token accounting for anything other than the provider calls the orchestrator makes; and the `stop` chunk's own `usage` shape, which providers already populate and this issue only aggregates.

Key files: `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` (the `lastUsage` local and the `afterModelResponse` call site), `src/types/ai.ts` (`UsageMetadata`), `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`.


--- DOD ---
# Definition of Done

> For a turn that called tools, it is the last leg of several, and the earlier rounds — including the one carrying the customer's question and the full tool results — are not counted anywhere. A deployer billing or budgeting from this hook under-counts exactly the expensive turns, and nothing in the signature hints at it.

**Strategy: `direct`** — `createChatOrchestrator` with a scripted provider and an `afterModelResponse` hook is the real entry point; the tests drive multi-round turns through it and assert on the `usage` the hook receives. Shape chosen: accumulate across rounds and pass the sum as the single `usage` argument (the per-round breakdown was rejected as wider public surface than any consumer has asked for; the sum changes what existing consumers record, so it ships as a MINOR bump with a changelog line).

## Done when these pass

- [ ] **reports 600 input, 60 output, 660 total for a two-tool-round turn whose calls report 100/10, 200/20 and 300/30** — a turn driven through two tool rounds reports usage covering all three provider calls
  `src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **counts only the rounds that reported usage, and reports undefined when none did** — a round with no usage neither drops nor poisons the sum; a turn with no usage at all still reports `undefined`
  `src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **receives collected response text and usage** (EXISTING, must stay green and unedited) — a turn with no tool calls reports exactly its single call's usage, as it does today
  `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`

## Facets

- [x] Accumulate per-round `usage` into a running turn total in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, adding a field-wise sum as a pure function, and pass the total to `afterModelResponse`
- [x] Make the hook's signature say it is a turn total (parameter name and one-line doc on `afterModelResponse`, or a named type alias over `UsageMetadata`), no `any`; regenerate the CLAUDE.md hooks block if it is generated from the declaration
- [x] Delete the under-counting bullet from "Measured semantics — out of scope" in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (the new "Usage reported to afterModelResponse" section replaces it) and re-anchor any shifted `#L` links
- [x] CHANGELOG entry stating that `afterModelResponse` now receives the sum across tool rounds, so existing consumers record larger numbers for tool-using turns; MINOR bump

## Out of scope

- The audit entry or billing record itself, which is a consumer's concern
- Token accounting for anything other than the provider calls the orchestrator makes
- The `stop` chunk's own `usage` shape, which providers already populate
- `onError` skipping non-`Error` rejections, the other measured-semantics bullet in the same spec

--- BRIEF FULL ---

item.text: The visible spec-name errors were stale test line anchors; the repository repair script repointed 16 citations, including the hook type test and three existing orchestrator tests. I also rewrote the duplicate scripted-provider helper in the existing unit test to remove the duplicated block and its now-unused suppression. I have not run any tests or lint commands.

 3. The orchestrator executes the tool (via `ToolRegistry.execute()`)

-5. If the tool returned `clientMessages`, they are forwarded to the frontend as-is, in one `tool_result` chunk ([validated by: forwards the client messages a tool returned as one tool_result chunk](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L463))

A round requested after that is not executed; see [the tool budget spec](../hal-engine-tool-budget/spec.md) ([validated by: executes 5 tool rounds and makes 6 provider calls at the default budget](../../src/orchestration/toolBudget.test.ts#L95), [validated by: stops asking for tools once maxToolRounds is spent](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L451))
 
 ### Whether a round continues
 
@@ -345,10 +345,10 @@ Here is what the message handler does when a tool call comes through:
 
 ### Across rounds
 
-- The loop ends as soon as a round stops with `end_turn`, and nothing further is asked of the provider ([validated by: stops after one round when nothing asked for a tool](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L440)).
-- An `entry_upsert` a tool returns is appended to the session and its index rewritten to the position it actually landed in, because a tool cannot know how long the session already is ([validated by: appends an upserted entry to the session and rewrites its index to match](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L476)).
-- The response text a hook sees is the text of every round joined, not only the last ([validated by: joins the text of every round, not only the last](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L505)).
-- Usage an earlier round reported is kept when a later round reports none, so a tool round does not erase the token count ([validated by: keeps the usage an earlier round reported when a later round reports none](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L527)).

+- The response text a hook sees is the text of every round joined, not only the last ([validated by: joins the text of every round, not only the last](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L507)).
+- Usage an earlier round reported is kept when a later round reports none, so a tool round does not erase the token count ([validated by: keeps the usage an earlier round reported when a later round reports none](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L529)).
 
 The frontend shows a spinner on the last tool entry while the stream is still processing (`isProcessing` is `true`). The `stream_end` message clears the processing state, which hides the spinner. This works correctly even when tool suppression prevents assistant entries from reaching the frontend. See [tool-responses.md](../hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md) for details on client messages and suppression.
 
diff --git a/specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md b/specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
index 491a11a..2e5d5ae 100644
--- a/specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
+++ b/specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
@@ -16,19 +16,19 @@
 - For a session that completes without error the hooks fire in the order `beforeSession` → `beforeUserInput` → `afterUserInput` → `beforeModelResponse` → `afterModelResponse` → `afterSession` ([validated by: fires the lifecycle hooks in documented order for a session that completes without error](../../src/config.test.ts#L132)).
 - A `beforeSession` that throws reaches the caller as a rejection, and also runs `onError` with the thrown error and then `afterSession`, because the call sits inside the same `try`/`finally` as the rest of the turn. An `afterSession` hook called under this condition can infer the session never advanced past `beforeSession`: no user-input hooks ran, no model response was generated, and no tool rounds were started — a cleanup hook that allocates in `beforeSession` and frees in `afterSession` will therefore always see the allocation and the release on the same error path ([validated by: runs onError then afterSession when it throws, and still rejects to the caller](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L116)).
 
-- Tool rounds stop after the configured `maxToolRounds` limit is spent ([validated by: stops asking for tools once maxToolRounds is spent](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L450)).
-- Tool results forward client messages in one `tool_result` chunk ([validated by: forwards the client messages a tool returned as one tool_result chunk](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L464)).
-- Tool returned upsert entries are appended to the session and their emitted index matches the appended entry ([validated by: appends an upserted entry to the session and rewrites its index to match](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L477)).
-- A tool result marked as suppressing the assistant response emits a suppression chunk ([validated by: asks for suppression when the tool says the reply is already handled](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L494)).
-- `afterModelResponse` receives concatenated response text from every round ([validated by: joins the text of every round, not only the last](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L506)).
+- Tool rounds stop after the configured `maxToolRounds` limit is spent ([validated by: stops asking for tools once maxToolRounds is spent](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L451)).
+- Tool results forward client messages in one `tool_result` chunk ([validated by: forwards the client messages a tool returned as one tool_result chunk](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L465)).
+- Tool returned upsert entries are appended to the session and their emitted index matches the appended entry ([validated by: appends an upserted entry to the session and rewrites its index to match](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L478)).
+- A tool result marked as suppressing the assistant response emits a suppression chunk ([validated by: asks for suppression when the tool says the reply is already handled](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L495)).
+- `afterModelResponse` receives concatenated response text from every round ([validated by: joins the text of every round, not only the last](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L507)).
 
 ## Usage reported to afterModelResponse
 
 - The `usage` handed to `afterModelResponse` is the sum of every provider call in the turn, so a turn that ran tool rounds reports the input, output and total tokens of all of them rather than of the last call alone ([validated by: reports 600 input, 60 output, 660 total for a two-tool-round turn whose calls report 100/10, 200/20 and 300/30](../../src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts#L60)).
 - A round whose provider reports no usage adds nothing to that sum and does not make it `undefined` or `NaN`, and a turn in which no round reported usage passes `undefined` ([validated by: counts only the rounds that reported usage, and reports undefined when none did](../../src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts#L70)).
 - A turn that ran no tools reports exactly the usage of its single provider call ([validated by: receives collected response text and usage](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L236)).
-- The hook's third argument is `TurnUsageMetadata`, naming it as the sum for the whole turn ([validated by: names the usage passed to afterModelResponse as a turn total](../../src/orchestration/turnUsageType.test.ts#L5)).
-- A usage value reported by an earlier round is retained when a later round reports none ([validated by: keeps the usage an earlier round reported when a later round reports none](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L533)).
+- The hook's third argument is `TurnUsageMetadata`, naming it as the sum for the whole turn ([validated by: names the usage passed to afterModelResponse as a turn total](../../src/orchestration/turnUsageType.test.ts#L6)).
+- A usage value reported by an earlier round is retained when a later round reports none ([validated by: keeps the usage an earlier round reported when a later round reports none](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L529)).
